violations.text: There was no person on site certified in food safety as required by RIDOH CFP when food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. PIC is to ensure a person certified in food safety is on site all times. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety that is registered with the RIDOH CFP. A person certified in food safety is to apply for Certified Food Safety Manager License as soon as possible. Application printed for PIC at the time of inspection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

Reduced Oxygen Packaged (ROP) Seafood, Crab Meat, labeled Keep Frozen was observed thawing in its intact packaging at 33 degrees Fahrenheit. Proper thawing of ROP Seafood was reviewed at the time of inspection. Crab was removed from packaging for thawing. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the bleach sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. Owner to ensure test strips are available on site at all times for testing. New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026
At the time of inspection, the menus were lacking an allergen awareness statement. An allergen awareness statement is to be provided for customer viewing. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety that is registered with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Application printed for Owner at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025

The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked with an asterisk. An asterisk is to be provided at the consumer advisory and at any food item on the menu that is served raw alerting to the customer to the consumer advisory provided. (Owner began adding asterisks at the time of inspection.) Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025

At the time of inspection, portioned rice was observed cooling in the low boy cooler tightly wrapped in plastic wrap and stacked directly on top of each other. Portioned rice was rearranged for rapid cooling at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods were discussed with the Owner at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025
